name: J.FRONT RETAILING Co.,Ltd.
summary: J. Front Retailing Co., Ltd. and its subsidiaries operate department stores through Department Store, Shopping Center, Developer, and Payment and Finance segments. The department store segment runs Daimaru and Matsuzakaya stores selling clothing, household goods and food, while other segments develop and operate shopping centers and offer financial services. It dates from 2007 and has its base in Tokyo, Japan.
